script_text: This week, Taurus, the cosmos is pulling the rug out from under your steady Earth foundation — and you need to pay attention. Early week, Venus squares Neptune in the 8th House, creating confusion around shared finances and intimate relationships. Monday and Tuesday bring a tense Mars-Saturn opposition blocking career progress and communication. Wednesday is better as the Moon enters your 10th House of public reputation. The mid-week shift comes Thursday when Mercury enters your 5th House of love, turning confusion into romantic clarity. Late week, Jupiter trines your ruling Venus, opening financial doors for income growth. The weekend brings a Sun-Moon conjunction in your 2nd House of income, making Sunday powerful for money decisions. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury enters your 5th House, enhancing romantic communication. Sunday is your worst day as the Sun-Moon square creates emotional friction around spending. Avoid signing contracts before Thursday clears your communication houses. Follow for daily updates.
